say:3:1421803002:1.text: This underground city is absolutely magnificent!
say:3:1421803002:1.source_cn: 难以想象，地底深处竟然有这样壮观的王城！

say:4:1421803003:1.text: A mysterious underground kingdom, the lost dwarven ruins, and the dragon soaring from the depths of the earth...
say:4:1421803003:1.source_cn: 神秘的地下王国，失落的矮人遗迹，由地底深处飞出的龙……

say:5:1421803004:1.text: We thought we were the quickest to act, but many of our peers still got here ahead of us...
say:5:1421803004:1.source_cn: 我们本以为自己是最早动身的学者，却还是有不少同事抢在了...

say:6:1421803005:1.text: By the way, we've heard a lot about your remarkable feat in Sal'thorin!
say:6:1421803005:1.source_cn: 不瞒您说，与梅林相关的传闻也在萨洛克兰满天飞呢！
say:6:1421803005:1.male: By the way, we've heard a lot about your remarkable feat in Sal'thorin!
say:6:1421803005:1.female: By the way, we've heard a lot about your remarkable feat in Sal'thorin!

say:7:1421803006:1.text: Now's my chance to ask you about it! Are those stories true?
say:7:1421803006:1.source_cn: 趁此机会我一定要问问您那些奇闻和壮举是不是真的！
say:7:1421803006:1.male: Now's my chance to ask you about it! Are those stories true?
say:7:1421803006:1.female: Now's my chance to ask you about it! Are those stories true?

say:8:1421803007:1.text: Hold your horses, Melissa. I know you're excited, but we need to stay focused on our priorities.
say:8:1421803007:1.source_cn: 等等梅丽莎，我理解你的激动，但别忘记我们的研究优先级。

say:9:1421803008:1.text: "The Study of Ancient Biomes" trumps everything!

choice_prompt:10:1421803008.text: "The Study of Ancient Biomes" trumps everything!

say:11:1421803009:1.text: Let me explain—out of all the things to study here, Gali has decided to study the subterranean ecosystem first.
say:11:1421803009:1.source_cn: 让我来解释吧……因为这里能研究的课题实在太多了，伽利想...

say:12:1421803010:1.text: He was inspired by a highly popular academic work by Fink, our senior at the Evergreen Conservatory. It's called "The Study of Ancient Biomes."
say:12:1421803010:1.source_cn: 这一想法得益于冬青学会的芬克前辈极为畅销的学术新著——...

say:13:1421803011:1.text: Gali's been so into this book lately that I'd call it borderline obsession...
say:13:1421803011:1.source_cn: 伽利最近很喜爱这本书，不，应该说是痴迷……

say:14:1421803012:1.text: Fink's masterpiece has inspired me! I'll make Sal'thorin's unique subterranean ecosystem the starting point of my research!
say:14:1421803012:1.source_cn: 芬克前辈的杰作启迪了我，把特殊的地底生态作为研究萨洛克...

say:15:1421803013:1.text: As archaeologists, it's important for us to study the history of both humanity and other life forms...
say:15:1421803013:1.source_cn: 身为考古学者，不仅要关心人类的历史，也要关心其他生命的...

say:16:1421803014:1.text: There's a jungle of giant mushrooms we want to visit. We thought about finding a local guide, but the Essail here aren't exactly fond of outsiders.
say:16:1421803014:1.source_cn: 我们听说地底有巨大伞状蕈菇组成的林地，本来想请当地人做...

choice_prompt:17:1421803014.text: There's a jungle of giant mushrooms we want to visit. We thought about finding a local guide, but the Essail here aren't exactly fond of outsiders.
choice_prompt:17:1421803014.source_cn: 我们听说地底有巨大伞状蕈菇组成的林地，本来想请当地人做向导，但这里的艾塞勒并不欢迎外人的到来。

say:18:1421803015:1.source_cn: 我的魔法师朋友，你还是这么热心且乐于助人！
